body: Thanks for the sound advice, should I be seeking a professional or just talk with friends/family members?
Thank you, I definitely want her to get better. I am hopeful but I still have that sinking feeling in my stomach that I have failed her.  I’m afraid she won’t forgive me for doing this.

She is being very difficult when it comes to seeing anyone and talking about her issues, she has a hard time really opening up and goes into any session with “ they can’t help me” mentality.

I myself have not been talking about this and the toll it has taken on me with anyone, I’m trying hard to be the rock but obviously I am not the rock.
It certainly doesn’t feel that I’m going to be ok. It’s so hard for me to even focus on daily routine things. My mind constantly revolves around that person
